description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class for a report related to products purchased in the OpenCart admin panel. The class extends a core Controller class and includes methods for displaying the report, saving its configuration, and retrieving report data.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Controller class for generating and managing the product purchased report within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the product purchased report form page, initializing language text, breadcrumbs, and loading layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the report configuration settings if the user has permission, returning success or error as JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares and displays the report page with data like report results and order statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list view with current report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data as a string, based on filtering parameters from the request.
